title: Construction/ Upgrading/ Rehabilitation of Drainage along National Roads, Urdaneta Jct-dagupan, Lingayen RD
description: CONSTRUCTION/ UPGRADING/ REHABILITATION OF DRAINAGE ALONG NATIONAL ROADS - SECONDARY ROADS, URDANETA JCT-DAGUPAN-LINGAYEN RD - K0208 + 234 - K0208 + 910
colour_meaning: Review: one strong sign of risk, or two weaker ones.

reasons.title: Price per km above 90% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱97.7M per km; the 90th percentile of similar works (Drainage along roads, 112 past contracts) is ₱97.0M per km. Length read from the title: 676 m.
reasons.evidence: A weaker version of the price sign.
checks: Check the stated length and the scope, as for the stronger price sign.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Flordes Construction & Trading Corp. (winner): 4 of 130 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

tests.text: Only one bidder at award (linked to late completion and to citizen-reported problems in past contracts)
